entries.en: Hm. Think we can help you with that.
entries.ro: Hm. Cred că te putem ajuta cu asta.

entries.en: Nothing. I sell grub, not advice. Don't know what you like to eat? I can't help you. Sorry, but not sorry. Not my problem.
entries.ro: Nimic. Eu vând mâncare, nu sfaturi. Nu știi ce-ți place? Nu te pot ajuta. Îmi pare rău, da' nu prea. Nu e problema mea.
